name: fade-out
concept: Opacity falls from fully visible to nothing, with no movement. The plainest way to say an element is leaving.

name: slide-out-up
concept: The element rises up and out of its resting position while fading out. Reads as content leaving toward the top, or a card being archived off the top of a list.

name: slide-out-down
concept: The element drops down and out of its resting position while fading out. Reads as content leaving toward the bottom, or a banner retracting.

name: slide-out-left
concept: The element travels left and out of its resting position while fading out. Reads as a swipe-to-dismiss gesture or a panel closing to the left.
keywords: swipe the card away to dismiss

name: slide-out-right
concept: The element travels right and out of its resting position while fading out. Reads as a swipe-to-dismiss gesture or a panel closing to the right.

name: scale-out
concept: The element shrinks from full size down to slightly smaller while fading out. A calmer, centered exit than a slide, good for closing cards and dialogs.
